text:
[LTHE.2.5.3] The anchor (first pattern) is pinned to its most
recent match **before the first follower**: an anchor `A` matched with a
follower `B` is excluded exactly when another anchor `A′`, with
`A.ts < A′.ts`, meets the sequence's order and windows in `A`'s place with the
same `B` and the same later facts, and none of the anchor's own `where` and
the followers' `where`s, with `A′` in `A`'s place, answers `false`. So `A′`
must precede `B` strictly ([LTHE.5.2]). An `A′` for which one of those
`where`s answers `null` and none answers `false` excludes `A`: "latest" cannot be concluded while a newer anchor's
eligibility is unknown, as a negated pattern is blocked by a candidate whose
condition is `null` ([LNUL.4.7]). An anchor that arrives after its follower,
or for which any of those `where`s answers `false`, excludes nothing; the
outcome depends on
timestamps and slot values, never on arrival order. Later patterns in the
sequence continue to match all candidates.

If the natural reading of the rule is "after the last X, did Y happen?", use
`latest`; if every X should count, leave it off.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__alphas_four
idris.note: THE ALPHAS OF THE CHAIN FIXTURES: four kinds admitting every fact, the emitted kind among them. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__anchor_at_follower_ts_does_not_exclude
idris.note: An anchor at the follower's own `ts` neither matches it nor excludes the earlier anchor: `A'` must precede `B` strictly. Executed, one firing on the anchor at 1.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__anchor_ts
idris.note: The anchor's `ts` off the bound facts, carried out by the fixtures' emit so a firing names its anchor. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__chain_later_anchor_does_not_exclude
idris.note: On a three-step chain an anchor after the first follower excludes nothing: the NOT sub-node after the last join orders the candidate against the first follower. Executed, one firing on the anchor at 1.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__chain_newer_anchor_excludes
idris.note: On a three-step chain a newer anchor before the first follower completes the chain with the same followers and excludes the older: one firing, on the anchor at 2. Executed.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__chain_rules
idris.note: THE `latest` CHAIN RULE: the anchor, two followers each joined to the step before it, then the NOT sub-node after the last join. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__earlier_anchor_is_excluded
idris.note: An anchor with a later one before the follower is excluded: one firing, on the anchor at 2. Executed, the `ts` shape of logical/LTHE.2.5.3_earlier_anchor_is_excluded.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__emit_anchor
idris.note: THE RHS OF THE `latest` FIXTURES: an emit carrying the anchor's `ts` into a kind no node reads, so the chain is framed. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__excludes
idris.note: THE EXCLUSION on `ts`: the NOT sub-node's join test after the sequence's last join, blocking the match on a candidate of the anchor's schema strictly after the anchor, strictly before the first follower and within its window. LESS than the clause: the anchor's `where` and every follower's `where` with the candidate in the anchor's place are the fixture lowering's conjuncts, evaluated by Rete/Eval.idr in the same test; the model's fact carries `ts` alone. On a substituted `where` that answers `null` the model and the clause agree: a NOT node blocks unless `false` ([LNUL.4.7]), and the clause takes the node's side, which logical/LTHE.2.5.3_null_candidate_excludes reaches on both runtimes. A substituted `where` that traps also blocks the node and is what the clause does not say.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__kind_pay
idris.note: A live fact's kind and payload, read off the trace: an emitted fact's payload is the `ts` of the anchor that fired. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__later_anchor_does_not_exclude
idris.note: An anchor after the follower on `ts`, asserted after it, excludes nothing whenever it arrived: one firing, on the anchor at 1. Executed, the `ts` shape of logical/LTHE.2.5.3_later_anchor_does_not_exclude.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__latest_rules
idris.note: THE `latest` SEQUENCE RULE: the anchor, the follower under the sequence's join, then the NOT sub-node on the anchor's alpha under the exclusion, after the last join. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__run
idris.note: THE RUN OF A `latest` FIXTURE: the inputs prepared with no run between them, then the traced pump with fuel 3, shown. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__shown
idris.note: What a traced run shows: the firings, the halt, each live fact's kind and payload. A fixture.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_5__later_steps_fan_out
idris.note: The anchor pinned, the later steps fanning out: two second-step facts, each followed by the third, two firings on the one anchor. Executed.
